lines.text: NASA rain over the Philippines, put to the test.
In El Niño years, January-to-April rain drops sixty percent, in every region. By chance? About four in a million.
From rainfall alone, machine learning finds the four official climate types.
Farms dry out, and crops lose green at all twelve sites, in line with damage reports.
But the slow rise in rain could still be chance. Telling them apart is trend detection.
